name: dmengine-fumo-resume
description: Mode C FUMO resume: the server serves only 64 of 184 object bytes with Accept-Ranges and an ETag. The engine retries with Range: bytes=64- and If-Range, the mock returns the remaining 120 bytes with 206, and the download completes with FUMO state 30 -> 40. No install or update-success claim is made.
